## intention

input: raw datafile\
output file: 01_dat_load.tsv

libraries:

```{r}
library("tidyverse")

```

get loaded file

```{r}
data<-source("01_load.qmd")
view(data)
```

Make every gene a column and the sample a row

```{r}
data_wrangled <- data |> select("ILMN_gene", starts_with("SAMPLE"))
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("SAMPLE"),
    names_to = "sample",
    values_to = "expression")
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = "ILMN_gene",
    values_from = "expression"
  )
    
```

sort patient after tissue type which is mentioned after the sample. we want to thereby we use regex to get the patient_id and tissue_types which duplicates

```{r}
data_tissue <- data_wrangled |> 
  mutate(
    patient_id = str_extract(sample, "\\d+")
    tissue_type = str_remove("^SAMPLE\\s+\\d+\\s+) |> 
  )

```
